name: @pinpoint/wording
comment: dependencies is intentionally absent, for the same reason @pinpoint/tokens has none: this holds the words the product says and a pure function that looks one up, and nothing else. It renders nothing and exports no component — one source of sentences, two applications drawing them in their own idiom. A runtime dependency here means something other than a sentence has been put in it. It also depends on no workspace package, so that every package which reports an outcome can name one without creating a cycle.
